messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager — metering-aggregator anomaly for tenant 'vanguardedge-prod' (VPC / dedicated pool us-west-2). Meter shows +420,312 tokens counted vs billing export for last 3h. Error rate 6.8% on token stream. Paging @elena (oncall) @dmitri (oncall) @mike (billing).
elena (oncall): ack — I'm awake, pulling logs now. tagging @ivy in case this is a routing/router issue.
dmitri (oncall): I'll take lead if you want to triage infra. grabbing the metering queue snapshots.
ivy (platform-eng): seeing a spike in retry traffic from gateway -> 5xx spikes at 2026-03-14T21:06Z, lots of retried requests with identical payloads. forwarding sample log lines.
incident-bot: Attached sample event: {tenant: "vanguardedge-prod", req_id: "r_9f2a3", tokens: 1024, ts: 1700000006, route: "/v1/generate"}. Aggregator dedupe window=30s, dedupe_key=req_id (but gateway can rewrite req_id on retry).
mike (billing): bigger problem — this tenant is on committed reserved pool and customer billing shows mismatch. Pause billing export until we know scope. please route any billing-impacting ops through me.
amanda (acct-exec): pinging VanguardEdge CSM, prepping a holding message. want to avoid overnotifying customers until we have mitigation.
elena (oncall): mitigation plan proposal (short):
  1) Pause metering-aggregation job for vanguardedge-prod (stream-level pause)
  2) Throttle tenant at edge to prevent further retries from inflating counts
  3) Snapshot current raw events and run dedupe offline to compute delta
  4) Apply temporary manual billing credit if delta > 100k tokens
Can someone run step 1 and 2?
ivy (platform-eng): I can throttle via the control plane. patching policy now.
sre-runner-bot: runbook triggered: MET-DEDUP-01. Steps logged.
ivy (platform-eng): throttle command applied:
```
POST /internal/tenants/vanguardedge-prod/actions
{ "action": "throttle", "rate": "50r/s", "note": "incident 1779012345" }
```
response: 202 accepted.
dmitri (oncall): pausing aggregator for that tenant:
```
# pause metering worker for tenant
curl -X POST \
  https://internal-api.redwood/v1/ops/metering/pause \
  -d '{"tenant":"vanguardedge-prod","reason":"incident-1779012345"}'
```
response: ok, paused. snapshot id: snap-20260314-2109
elena (oncall): good. now we need to compute the delta. running query against raw events export (will take ~4m).
ivy (platform-eng): quick helper SQL I ran to sanity-check counts: 
```sql
SELECT tenant_id, count(*) as events, sum(tokens) as tokens_sum
FROM raw_meter_events
WHERE tenant_id='vanguardedge-prod' AND ts > now() - interval '6 hours'
GROUP BY tenant_id;
```
result (preliminary): events=12,312 rows, tokens_sum=4,020,312 vs billing_export tokens=3,600,000 (delta ~420,312)
mike (billing): thanks — put a hold on automated invoices for that tenant. I'll create an internal billing ticket and will not bill the delta until postmortem.
amanda (acct-exec): drafting customer-facing hold message: "We detected an internal metering issue impacting token counts for your VPC deployment. We are investigating and will not bill you for suspected duplicate counts while we sort this out." will wait for final numbers.
dmitri (oncall): digging into why duplicates happened. snapshot analysis shows many events with same payload but different req_id; retries were coming from edge and gateway ip rotation. looks like gateway retries are generating new req_id instead of preserving original. dedupe_key currently is req_id so duplicates bypass dedupe.
elena (oncall): that matches what I suspected. root cause hypothesis: gateway retry path doesn't carry original request id -> aggregator dedupe uses req_id -> double count.
ivy (platform-eng): quick mitigation: expand dedupe key to include hash(payload) + tenant + route for 24h window. I can test a hotfix on a canary aggregator.
ivy (platform-eng): patch ready, testing on canary now.
sre-runner-bot: canary deploy started for meter-agg service.
(10m later)
ivy (platform-eng): canary looks clean. dedupe by payload-hash removed duplicate counts on test tenant. preparing rollout to all aggregator instances in us-west-2 dedicated pools.
dmitri (oncall): rolling patch to aggregators in us-west-2 (staggered). will monitor token delta.
incident-bot: monitor alert: dedup-success metric up, duplicate-event-rate down from 5.8% -> 0.2% in canary.
elena (oncall): good signal. after full rollout will reprocess snapshot with new dedupe logic to compute corrected billed tokens.
dmitri (oncall): full rollout complete at 2026-03-14T21:41Z. reprocessing snapshot now (offline re-dedupe job). estimated complete in 12m.
(12m later)
dmitri (oncall): reprocess complete. corrected tokens_sum=3,600,005 (~within noise). delta effectively removed.
amanda (acct-exec): based on corrected numbers, proposed customer credit = 0 (no overage) but need to confirm if any inadvertent charges occurred between snapshot and pause. @mike please confirm.
mike (billing): confirmed automated billing export was paused before any invoice generation. no charges applied for delta window. will mark for manual review and close.
elena (oncall): next steps:
  - create postmortem and link to this thread (owner: elena)
  - follow-up deploy to ensure dedupe key change is in all regions (owner: ivy)
  - account team to send customer communication (owner: amanda)
  - billing to verify no invoices (owner: mike)

customer-comms: draft sent to customer: "We identified an internal metering duplicate-count bug affecting VPC dedicated deployments. We have applied a fix and reprocessed your data; no billing impact expected. We will follow up with a short postmortem and the corrective steps we put in place."
elena (oncall): handing off to dmitri for next 2 hours for follow-up and postmortem. then we'll close the incident.
dmitri (oncall): got it — I'll own the postmortem doc and follow-ups. closing on-call window.
incident-bot: Incident 1779012345 status: mitigated -> monitoring. root cause: gateway retries caused req_id churn leading to duplicated metering counts. fix: dedupe key expanded to payload-hash + tenant + route; canary + full rollout in us-west-2 complete. credits: none required; billing export paused during window. Postmortem ticket created: PMT-2026-045.
elena (oncall): marked resolved in pager duty and archiving thread. thanks everyone :thumbsup:
